title: REQ · Submit validates input and quota and shows disabled, loading and inline feedback states
summary: Validate empty, over-length and quota-exhausted input; show submit loading and success or error feedback
description: Context: handleSubmit silently ignores empty text, has no length check, allows sending past quota and has no success message. Desired behavior: client-side validation with inline messages, Send disabled while sending or quota is exhausted, and a visible success message. Expected result: invalid submissions never reach the API. Why: clear feedback and fewer wasted calls.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty or whitespace text, when Send is clicked, then a role=alert 'Enter an idea before sending' shows and fetch is not called
Given text longer than 500 characters, when Send is clicked, then a role=alert mentioning the 500 character limit shows and fetch is not called
Given remaining is 0, then the textarea and Send are disabled and 'No contributions left' shows
Given a submit in flight, then Send is disabled and reads 'Sending…'; on success a role=status 'Idea sent' shows; on API error the mapped error shows in role=alert

in_scope: Validation, submit states and feedback in ContributionSheet

technical_constraints: MAX_PROMPT_LEN = 500 mirrors MaxPromptLen in backend/internal/contribution/service.go (rune count)
